constraints.definition: CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= not_before)
CHECK (sequence = 1 AND prior_event_hash IS NULL OR sequence > 1 AND prior_event_hash IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (actual_cost_micros IS NULL OR actual_cost_micros >= 0 AND actual_cost_micros <= estimated_cost_micros)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER managed_audit_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON __schema__.managed_audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION __schema__.reject_managed_audit_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER managed_audit_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON __schema__.managed_audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION __schema__.reject_managed_audit_mutation()

functions.name: lock_managed_api_key_share
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION __schema__.lock_managed_api_key_share(p_tenant_id text, p_key_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1
    FROM __schema__.managed_api_keys
   WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND key_id = p_key_id
   FOR SHARE;
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

functions.name: lock_managed_tenant_share
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION __schema__.lock_managed_tenant_share(p_tenant_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_status text;
BEGIN
  SELECT status INTO v_status
    FROM __schema__.managed_tenants
   WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id
   FOR SHARE;
  RETURN v_status;
END;
$function$

functions.name: lock_managed_tenant_update
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION __schema__.lock_managed_tenant_update(p_tenant_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id text, status text, daily_budget_micros bigint, max_invocation_cost_micros bigint, max_concurrent_invocations integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT t.tenant_id, t.status, t.daily_budget_micros,
         t.max_invocation_cost_micros, t.max_concurrent_invocations
    FROM __schema__.managed_tenants AS t
   WHERE t.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
   FOR UPDATE;
END;
$function$

functions.name: reject_managed_audit_mutation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION __schema__.reject_managed_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'risk fork managed audit events are append-only'
    USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END;
$function$
